title: 听力挑战 · 描述理想公寓

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What kind of apartment are you looking for?

grammar.name: 定语从句 that 引导
grammar.note: that has... 作定语修饰名词,说明公寓的特征。

options.text: One that has a big balcony and sunlight.
options.feedback: that 引导定语从句描述想要的公寓特征,回答完整。

options.text: One where I lost my keys.
options.feedback: 说的是丢钥匙的地方,与找房需求无关。
谈的是房租趋势,没有回答要找什么样的房子。

rounds.speaker: 中介
rounds.line: Which floor do you prefer to live on?

grammar.name: 定语从句修饰楼层
grammar.note: that is quiet 修饰 floor,说明理想楼层的条件。

options.text: I prefer a floor that is quiet and bright.
options.feedback: that 从句修饰 floor,说出理想楼层的特点。

options.text: I lived on the fifth floor before.
options.feedback: 过去时谈以前的住处,不是现在的偏好。

options.text: The building is twenty years old.
options.feedback: 描述楼龄,没有回答楼层偏好。

rounds.speaker: 朋友
rounds.line: What do you think about the neighborhood you want?
rounds.lineCn: 你觉得你想要的社区环境怎么样?

grammar.name: 定语从句省略关系词
grammar.note: the neighborhood (that) you want 中关系词 that 可省略。

options.text: I want a neighborhood that is close to the subway.
options.feedback: that 引导定语从句描述理想社区,回应完整。

options.text: I have a neighbor who plays the piano.
options.feedback: 谈的是现实邻居,而不是理想的社区环境。

options.text: The subway is far from my office.
options.feedback: 谈地铁与办公室的距离,没有回答社区偏好。
